# HelloTalk

> > HelloTalk is a comprehensive language learning platform connecting millions of learners worldwide through AI-powered tools, native speaker exchange, and certified teachers across 260+ languages.

Founded with offices in Beijing, Bangkok, and Lagos, HelloTalk offers an ecosystem of 25+ specialized AI apps including HelloWords, SpeakUp AI, Wordia, and LanguageClass. The platform serves learners preparing for IELTS, TOEFL, and HSK exams through features like immersive translation, voice rooms, live streaming, and professional tutoring.

## Key Topics

- AI-powered language learning
- Language exchange with native speakers
- Real-time translation (260+ languages)
- Conversation practice and voice rooms
- Exam preparation (IELTS, TOEFL, HSK)
- Certified language teachers
- Pronunciation training
- Grammar explanations and contextual learning
- Vocabulary building
- HelloWords and specialized AI apps
- Visual and voice translation
- Live streaming lessons
- Personalized learning paths
- Social learning through Moments
- Etymology exploration with Wordia
